name: Fluent Bit
listed_description: Log processor and forwarder written in C that plugs into Fluentd and can ship logs and system metrics to Elasticsearch or InfluxDB.
claim_text: Written in C, a faster and lighter solution that plugs into Fluentd; no numbers given.
found_in: book: Software Architecture with C++, 2nd ed. (2025), ch. 17, Unified logging, Fluent Bit

name: Envoy
listed_description: C++ service proxy at the core of Istio, comparable to NGINX or HAProxy but reconfigurable on the fly through an API and extensible with WebAssembly.
claim_text: Two notable aspects of Envoy are its performance and popularity; no numbers given.
found_in: book: Software Architecture with C++, 2nd ed. (2025), ch. 18, Service mesh solutions, Istio
